description: Redacts emails, phone numbers, SSNs, credit cards, API keys, and crypto private keys from text before logging or external transmission. Use when stripping personal data or secret credentials from prompts, logs, or outbound messages; for neutralizing indirect prompt injections and invisible Unicode in inbound tool responses, use sanitize_tool_output_stream instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'text' ('redaction_style' defaults to 'typed_token'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

redaction_style.description: Placeholder format used for redacted spans; defaults to 'typed_token' when omitted.

text.description: Input text containing potential PII or secret keys to redact.

name: redact_sensitive_pii

redactions_count.description: Total number of sensitive entities redacted.

scrubbed_text.description: Sanitized text with all sensitive entities replaced by redaction tokens.

zero_pii_certified.description: True when post-scan verification confirms zero residual PII patterns.

title: Zero-PII & Secret Credential Redaction Engine
